name: Victor Wembanyama
lede: Three games, 39.7 points a night: 50 on 20-of-29 shooting against the Pelicans, 44 at Portland, then 25 and 16 rebounds as the Spurs came back from 20 down to beat the Lakers.
dek: 39.7 a night this week, and the one-legged fade he spent the summer building.

move.title: The one-legged fade
move.text: Dirk Nowitzki's one-legged fadeaway, the move he worked on all summer. Back to the basket on the block, he bumps his man for a sliver of space, turns on his right foot and fades off his left with the right knee up. Air Alamo: “there's no way anyone can reach the apex of his shot.” In games it's still a work in progress, the Express-News reported on Nov 16.
steps: Back to the rim on the block. Two bumps for a sliver of space.
He turns on his right foot to face up.
Off the left foot, right knee up, falling away from the rim. The release is out of reach.

note: He sat the Nov 23 win at Sacramento (back tightness). Nov 21 rebounds left blank: the box scores say 18, the written recaps say 19.
